limits: Three native pairs per workload are a small sample.
Cold first/root diagnostic requests differ from warmed post-edit requests.
Native server latency is not full editor/Neovim/tsrs latency.
Actual consumer factoring differs between release pins; timings do not isolate one framework encoding.
No forced GC; RSS is sampled and not allocation or retained heap.
Rendering totals exclude boot/waits and do not isolate DOM patching or presentation.
One machine/browser batch does not establish arbitrary-application scalability.
